before: Inline content controls showed their extent only as boundary chrome over the page; a host could not show where each control opens and closes in the flow of the text.
after: surface.setContentControlTags installs a host labeler that draws view-only start and end chips for inline controls (Word's Design Mode): zero-width layout pieces at the control's edges, coloured by a host tone, in the body, table cells and text boxes.
reason: The tags are layout and paint only. They never enter the document, an operation, the journal or an export; offsets, saved bytes and shared state are identical with or without them, so released participants are unaffected.
